jobs.title: Program Manager, Business Transformation & Platform Operations
jobs.why: Exceptional match for business transformation, process improvement, reporting, workflow automation, requirements gathering, testing, training, documentation, and cross-functional execution in healthcare. The posting specifically calls out Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Automate, CRM/enterprise platforms, dashboards, data quality, and business analysis.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 5+ years across program management/business transformation and values Power BI, Dynamics, Lean/Six Sigma, and formal PM/BA credentials. Emphasize hands-on systems projects, Power Automate/SharePoint work, reporting, process design, and healthcare operations; do not overstate tools or certifications not held.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent behavioral-health operations fit centered on provider quality, scalable operational programs, clinical workflows, cross-functional execution, data-driven decision making, and tools such as Salesforce/BI platforms. Strong overlap with ABA/behavioral-health operations and systems/process improvement.
jobs.gap: The role favors high-growth health-tech experience and strong analytical depth with large datasets. Position SQL only as foundational/working knowledge and lead with operational analysis, healthcare workflows, reporting, CRM/process systems, and execution.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Transformation
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Travel to Boston
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation role leading complex health-system programs, operational readiness, clinical workflows, stakeholder coordination, process optimization, go-lives, and AI-enabled transformation. The implementation and workflow focus maps closely to healthcare operations and systems-project experience.
jobs.gap: Specialty pharmacy, EMR integration, 340B, and medication-access experience are domain gaps. Emphasize healthcare operations, workflow design, implementation, documentation, training, project coordination, and process improvement as the transferable core.

jobs.title: Deployment Program Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Remote with regular hospital travel
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare-tech implementation opportunity involving hospital operations, customer deployments, dashboards, reporting automation, stakeholder management, and translating between technical and business teams. The hospital workflow and implementation focus is highly relevant.
jobs.gap: The role prefers pre-sales/sales-engineering or technical deployment experience and requires significant travel to hospital sites. Emphasize implementation ownership, systems troubleshooting, stakeholder communication, workflow design, and healthcare operations while being clear about hardware/deployment depth.

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong direct healthcare-operations match with departmental operations, reporting, budgeting, project support, practice-management coordination, marketing/communications, and cross-functional work across a major health system. The role's combination of operations and communications fits the background unusually well.
jobs.gap: The lower end of the salary band is below target, so compensation should be discussed early. Some duties are finance/budget heavy; emphasize reporting, operational coordination, healthcare experience, communications, and analytical support.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - West Coast Preferred
jobs.location: United States · Remote · Up to 80% travel
jobs.why: Healthcare-tech implementation role owning the full customer lifecycle from scoping and project planning through implementation, training, post-launch support, stakeholder management, and process optimization. Strong overlap with onboarding, training, implementation, and healthcare operations work.
jobs.gap: West Coast is preferred, travel can reach 80%, and the posting prefers hardware/software implementation experience plus 5+ years and PMP. Treat as a stretch unless the travel level is acceptable and emphasize project ownership, training, process improvement, and healthcare systems experience.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager (Insights & AI)
jobs.why: Compelling mental-health-tech growth-operations role combining AI-enabled workflows, self-service analytics, reporting infrastructure, operating cadences, partner strategy, and cross-functional execution. Strong fit for CRM/automation/reporting strengths in a healthcare setting.
jobs.gap: The posting explicitly wants fluent SQL/data modeling and 5–7 years in consulting, banking, analytics, or strategy & operations. Keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge and emphasize reporting, automation, CRM systems, healthcare domain knowledge, and operational problem solving.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Transformation Partner
jobs.why: Strong healthcare transformation role focused on workflow friction, process improvement, cross-functional initiatives, AI enablement, automation, change adoption, and translating ambiguous business needs into coordinated action. The healthcare and systems-transformation mix is highly relevant.
jobs.gap: This is a senior stretch role requiring 8+ years of transformation/operations/program experience and familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma/change management. Lead with accumulated operations, systems, business-analysis, and healthcare experience without inflating tenure or certifications.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: High-upside business-operations role involving new tools and processes, GTM enablement, cross-functional initiatives, quantitative analysis, and executive-facing projects. Strong alignment with systems implementation, workflow automation, reporting, and broad operational ownership.
jobs.gap: Modal wants 5+ years in a business function and some exposure to tech/coding, plus deeper pricing/finance analysis than the current profile shows. Emphasize systems fluency, business analysis, implementation, reporting, automation, and fast learning.

jobs.title: Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.why: Growth-operations option with strong process, technical onboarding, data QA, runbook/documentation, reporting, workflow standardization, and cross-functional troubleshooting responsibilities. It provides a useful non-healthcare track while keeping the work systems-heavy rather than SEO-led.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 3+ years in ad operations/adtech, DSP experience, pixel/attribution expertise, and working SQL. Those are meaningful gaps, so treat this as a stretch and position foundational SQL plus prior marketing/SEO background, analytics, QA, process documentation, and technical troubleshooting accurately.
